name: University of Glasgow
feeMethod: Charges undergraduates one rate per subject band, so the calculator uses the band's rate; each master's has its own fee.
description: The University of Glasgow, founded in 1451, is the fourth-oldest university in the English-speaking world and a member of the Russell Group of research universities. It teaches across arts, social sciences, science and engineering, and medical, veterinary and life sciences.
whyIncluded: Glasgow runs joint degrees with the Singapore Institute of Technology, taught in Singapore to polytechnic graduates, in computing science, mechanical engineering and nursing. Its medical degree is recognised by the Singapore Medical Council for practice in Singapore.

livingCosts.summary: The University of Glasgow's own undergraduate budget for a 36-week academic year (2026-27 figures), spread over 9 months. Excludes tuition, flights, visa and health surcharge.
livingCosts.notes: Glasgow's US Loans 'Cost of Living 2026/27' page (Registry, read 2026-10-14; replaces the 2023/24 federalloans page, now 404), undergraduate 36-week budget: rent GBP 210/wk (7,560), utilities incl. mobile 75/wk (2,700), food 85/wk (3,060), daily travel 45/wk (1,620), books/computer 40/wk (1,440), personal 80/wk (2,880). Housing = rent + utilities (10,260/9); food 3,060/9; transport 1,620/9; personal = books + personal (4,320/9). Flights, visa and IHS excluded. The general cost-of-living page (gla.ac.uk/study/studentlife/costofliving, August 2026) gives only a range of GBP 1,100 to 1,700 a month with no breakdown.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng
programmes.feeBasis: Glasgow's 2027/28 international undergraduate rate for its Science, Engineering, Nursing and Life Sciences band (£33,708 a year), which covers this degree.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2027. Glasgow sets a new rate each year, so later years of the degree may cost more. No separate compulsory fees.
programmes.notes: International undergraduate fee for 2027/28 entrants, band 'Science, Engineering, Nursing, Medical/Veterinary/Life Sciences', from the University of Glasgow international fees page (read 2026-10-07; 2026/27 rate on the same page 33210). Programme band inferred from the award/college as listed on that page; 4-year Scottish honours degree. Glasgow publishes one international rate per academic year and states that fees quoted are for new entrants and that different fees may apply to some continuing students; it does not guarantee a fixed fee for the duration, so cohortLocked is false. feeHistory rows are the international rate in the MyGlasgow fee table for that academic year. Only charge besides tuition is a GBP 170 registration fee for students re-sitting exams, not applicable to normal progression, so annualCompulsoryFees 0.
